criterion: session.memory.set preserves compositional rules, favorite instruments, sound palettes, scale preferences and stylistic heuristics across studio restarts. Retain a multi-session restart test asserting recalled memory.
scope: Native QCoreApplication executable: seven process starts, two independent session directories, eighteen exact memory/manifest comparisons, six clean exits and one deliberate SIGKILL recovery. Rich palettes, scales, compositional rules and style heuristics recalled across repeated restarts. Existing operation and persistence contract; no native feature change.
limitations: Observed macOS arm64 headless Debug build only. No power-loss durability, arbitrary file tamper recovery, automatic taste inference, real-provider musical acceptance, physical audio/MIDI, cross-platform or full 194-test suite claim. Revision identifies the base commit; source hashes identify the tested working-tree fixture and unchanged native sources.
verified_invariants: Explicit favorite instruments, nested sound palettes, scale preferences, compositional rules, style heuristics and Unicode notes exactly match session.inspect and the independently read committed manifest.
Preferences survive clean restarts and an abrupt kill after acknowledged replacement; native tempo and note data survive alongside the memory.
Separate session directories remain isolated, including reuse of the same request ID in each session.
Setter replaces the whole object, rejected malformed inputs preserve memory, and an explicitly empty object stays cleared after restart.
Replayed acknowledged requests return their old response without overwriting newer memory; conflicting request-ID content is rejected.
Native project undo preserves the current preference object.
